body:
Phase 1. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md.

- Room migration: `expense` on ItemEntity (JSON + clock), `currency` on
  ListEntity (+ clock), members / close_votes / closed_at on ListEntity
  (server-maintained, no clock). DTOs, repos.
- SplitMath, pure and unit-tested: equal split in cents with leftover cents
  to the first members in join order; fixed/auto rebalancing; the two
  invalid states; reload from the equal_* flags.
- BalanceMath, pure and unit-tested: per participant paid / share / balance,
  former-member numbering by first appearance, sums to zero, solo list.
- Duplicate-name check off for expense lists.

Same case table as the web ticket; the two must agree to the cent.
title: expenses: Android — data layer, migration, split and balance arithmetic
